'''Kant''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located deep within [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan space]]. Kant had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], which themselves had many [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] companions. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Chratis]] stationed his division near there.
